description: This file defines the 'Model' class within the MPF\Core\DB namespace, providing an ORM-like interface for database table operations such as defining schema, querying, joining, updating, deleting, and migration handling. It manages database interactions, schema creation, and modifications with various methods for CRUD operations and relationship management.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A class providing ORM features for database table management, including schema migrations, CRUD operations, query building with joins and conditions, and other database interaction utilities within the MPF\Core\DB namespace.

methods.name: PK
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for primary key column definition.

methods.name: int
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for integer column with optional nullability and default value.

methods.name: char
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for VARCHAR column with specified length, nullability, and default value.

methods.name: decimal
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for DECIMAL column with specified precision, scale, nullability, and default.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for TEXT column with optional nullability.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for boolean column with optional nullability and default value.

methods.name: enum
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for ENUM column with specified choices, nullability, and default.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for DATE column with optional default current date and nullability.

methods.name: datetime
methods.description: Static method returning the SQL string for DATETIME column with optional default current timestamp and nullability.

methods.name: GETCOL
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the column definition from the model's fields array, or debug if not present.

methods.name: FK
methods.description: Static method to generate foreign key SQL snippet based on references to other models and columns, enforcing INT type.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Instance method returning the name of the table associated with the model.

methods.name: migration
methods.description: Private method to generate and save a migration class based on current model schema.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Public method to handle migration creation, verification, and table creation or updating to match model fields.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Private method to construct and execute SQL for creating a new table based on model's fields and foreign keys.

methods.name: verifyTable
methods.description: Private method to check if the associated table exists in the database.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Public method to drop the associated table, resetting the schema.

methods.name: editTable
methods.description: Private method handling schema alterations: adding, modifying, or removing columns with support for foreign keys.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Static method to delete records based on provided key-value conditions, disables calls after 'find'.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Static method to initialize a query builder for selecting columns with optional conditions.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Static method to construct a COUNT query.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Instance method to add WHERE conditions to the query.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Instance method to add AND conditions, to be called after 'where'.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Instance method to add OR conditions, to be called after 'where'.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Instance method to specify ORDER BY clause with column and order.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Instance method to add LIMIT (and offset) to the query.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Static method to prepare an UPDATE statement with specified values, to be executed after query building.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Instance method to define an INNER JOIN with another table and specify columns.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Instance method to define join ON conditions with various comparison operators.

methods.name: onor
methods.description: Instance method similar to 'on' that combines conditions with OR instead of AND for join clauses.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Method to execute the constructed query, returning fetched data or operation success indicators.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Static method to insert a new record with provided values, returning the inserted record with generated ID.

methods.name: RawQuery
methods.description: Static method for executing raw SQL queries, returning all fetched results.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Static method returning a greater-than operator array for query conditions.

methods.name: gte
methods.description: Static method returning a greater-than-or-equal operator array for query conditions.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Static method returning a less-than operator array for query conditions.

methods.name: lte
methods.description: Static method returning a less-than-or-equal operator array for query conditions.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Static method returning a LIKE operator array for query conditions.
